summary: Render feature dispatcher. Tests sub_50FC7D(); if non-zero it selects sub_503772 for both global dispatch slots, otherwise it selects ImageBlendingCompositing for off_5D76C0 and F_2DImageBoxFilter for the held local. The chosen handler is stored in off_5D76C4 and then invoked via indirect call; its result is returned.

local_names.v0: selected render handler, later written to off_5D76C4 and called

operations.description: Branch on the result of sub_50FC7D(); non-zero selects the first handler set.
True branch: write sub_503772 into off_5D76C0.
True branch: hold sub_503772 as the local handler v0.
False branch: write ImageBlendingCompositing into off_5D76C0.
False branch: hold F_2DImageBoxFilter as the local handler v0.
Write the selected handler v0 into off_5D76C4.
Invoke the selected handler through v0 and return its result.

unresolved: The role of off_5D76C0 versus off_5D76C4 (two dispatch slots storing the same handler) is unknown.
The meaning of the sub_50FC7D() predicate is unknown.
Whether F_2DImageBoxFilter and ImageBlendingCompositing are the true branch or fallback path is only structurally inferred from the prelabel cluster copy.
